name: חילוק שברים רציונליים – פירוק מכנה ריבועי וצמצום (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Express the following as a single fraction: \[ \frac{{CT:0}}{{CT:1}}\div\frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}}. \]
(Hint: Try factorising the fractions.)

[[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
When dividing fractions you can save work if the denominator or numerator of one fraction has common factors with the denominator or numerator respectively. Factorising these fractions gives:
\[ \frac{{CT:0}}{{CT:4}}\div\frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}}. \]
It is clear that the factor \({{CT:5}}\) is common in both fractions and so we can cancel \({{CT:5}}\):
\[ \frac{{CT:0}}{{CT:6}}\div{{CT:2}} = {{CT:7}}. \]

on_false.feedback: Your answer is a single fraction but it is not expressed in it's simplest terms.
